Container.Name: yondrive
Container.Overview: Self-hosted files, documents and notes with zero-knowledge encryption. By default everything is encrypted in the browser before it is uploaded, so the server holds only ciphertext. One container, one data directory; open the web app and follow the setup wizard. The container logs a one-time setup link on first start.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Host port for the web app and API.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Where YonDrive keeps its database and stored files. The container runs as nobody:users (99:100), so this path must be owned by that user; Unraid creates it that way. Back it up by copying the directory.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Address people use to reach YonDrive, such as https://drive.example.com. Used in share links and for single sign-on. Leave empty to set it in the setup wizard.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Address or CIDR range of the reverse proxy, comma-separated for several. Its forwarded headers are then believed, so YonDrive sees the visitor's address and whether the connection is HTTPS. Leave empty without a proxy.

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: auto follows the HTTPS status reported by a trusted proxy. Use true when everything is served over HTTPS, false to force plain HTTP behaviour.

Config.Name: Extra certificate authorities
Config.Description: PEM file of certificate authorities to trust as well as the image's bundle, for an identity provider behind an internal one. Put it in the data directory and give its path inside the container, such as /data/ca.pem. The server does not start if it cannot read it.
